author: azeropi

title: Great app
body:
I highly recommend it. Its simple and easy to use design makes it clutter free and practical.

While I initially found the app useful for tracking the habits I wanted to quit, it soon became clear that the app is so much more versatile than that.

You can track the habits you want to quit, and see your progress, but, you can also track the healthy habits you’re replacing the bad ones with, and see your progress that way, like how many days since you exercised, read a book, ect. Need to track how often your newborn is eating? Great app for that too. It’s great you can have it all in one place.

The best thing is that it’s so easy to use and customize, that whatever you need to keep track of in your life, this is the only app you’ll want to use for it.
